headline: Sixteen matches in, the LSC table is still empty, and conference play is 23 days away.
dek: Sixteen matches carry a published final score out of 151 on the season calendar. Three more are marked final with no score published, and three sit past their date with no result recorded.

summary_stat.label: Matches played
summary_stat.detail: Sixteen matches carry a published final score; the season calendar holds 151 in all.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Midwestern State has scored eleven goals in non-conference play, more than any two other programmes have scored together.

chart.caption: Goals scored against opponents from outside the conference, by programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: All three matches marked final without a published score are Lubbock Christian's — August 15, August 19 and August 22 — and three further matches are past their date with no result recorded.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Against opponents from outside the conference the LSC programmes have won eight, drawn one and lost five, scoring 29 goals and conceding 24.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oklahoma Christian has scored four goals in non-conference play and conceded none.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four different St. Edward's players have scored in the collected records: Bartek Zabek, Holden Rabb, Jake Ciccarello and Nemanja Pavicevic.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made eleven saves for Sul Ross State, more than any other keeper in the collected records.

last_match.line: Cal State Dominguez Hills 0-3 St. Edward's, the only match collected on August 30.

next_match.line: Texas A&M International away to West Alabama at 16:00, the only match on the day.

table_state.statement: No conference match has been played, so no programme has a conference record yet and the table carries early form from non-conference results only.
table_state.footnote: Conference play opens September 23, 23 days after this collection · sixteen matches are played and three finals carry no score, counted beside that figure and never inside it · a pre-conference table is a valid state.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
